title: Elodie and the Radiators
author: Cyrus Iversen
blurb: Tamsin Galloway, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has spent twenty years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
